CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE

   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.
   D. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
